rubrics.baseline_defect: Session interprets fragment completeness and consumes protocol queues.
rubrics.criterion: Give complete-message readiness and consumption a coherent protocol responsibility.
rubrics.acceptance: Preserve incomplete versus zero-length admission, whole-message consumption, pool release, direct/staged choice and unread suffix; session locking and BytesReceived reflect actual application bytes. Equivalent functions, policy data, composition or a redesigned flow qualify; no prescribed helper, class, file, return object or one-component-per-item design is required. One coherent redesign may satisfy multiple independent items.
insufficient_repairs: Relocating unchanged consumer-owned foreign-state manipulation without a coherent policy boundary is insufficient.
